metadata.description: Custom Claude Code plugins — multi-phase AI development pipeline (essense-flow + autopilot), a living-model steward loop, /elicit for brainstorming a vision to completion, a queryable project knowledge base (kb), one blocking turn-end hook the others hang duties on, design-pattern and reuse gates, data exploration, prompt modifiers, question tracking, and cross-platform alerts.

plugins.name: essense-flow
plugins.description: Multi-phase development pipeline: elicit, research, triage, architect, build, review, verify. Closed task specs, evidence-bound review, and every agent self-report re-checked against disk.

plugins.name: essense-autopilot
plugins.description: Stop-hook autopilot for essense-flow: advances the pipeline between phases without you typing, and halts loudly at human gates, real blockers, and in-flight agents.

plugins.name: schema-scout
plugins.description: Explore the schema and values of any XLSX, CSV or JSON file from the CLI. Detects JSON inside cells, repairs double-encoded UTF-8, prunes overflow and null columns.

plugins.name: thorough-mode
plugins.description: Prompt modifiers that inject behavioral rules on a keyword: ++/@thorough, @ship, @present, @debug, @verify, @fresh, @prompt, @build, @fc. Hooks only — no skill to remember.

plugins.name: project-note-tracker
plugins.description: Track questions and bugs per handler in an Excel tracker: auto-routes each question to the right department, researches from project context, generates meeting agendas.

plugins.name: alert-sounds
plugins.description: Cross-platform alerts for Claude Code events — sound, desktop notification, statusline color, volume and mute, each configurable per event.

plugins.name: session-lifecycle
plugins.description: Session continuity: /handoff writes an append-only history, /resume restores it, /claude-md-sync proposes doc updates, /retro and /meta-review look back at how it went.

plugins.name: plugin-toolkit
plugins.description: Build and maintain Claude Code plugins: skill-heal, plugin-scaffold, version-bump, docs-audit, code-glossary, dry-refactor, plus repo-guard, test-all, registry-check and harness-stats gates.

plugins.name: verifiability-lens
plugins.description: A strict work-quality guardian: sorts every claim into verified, unverifiable or cannot-tell, reads the code and docs to confirm or refute it, and presses unfinished work to continue.

plugins.name: reuse-gate
plugins.description: Reuse-first reminder at the moment code is written: one nudge per message on the first source write — is this already implemented here, or served by a library you already have?

plugins.name: steward
plugins.description: A living model per project (.steward/: vision, state, parts, questions, tasks). Stray thoughts land in an inbox; the steward agent recomputes the whole model and shows you the diff.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Segment-based statusline: model, current task, directory, steward anchor, and a normalized context-usage bar. Each segment fails soft; extend it by adding one function.

plugins.name: kb
plugins.description: The project's queryable knowledge base — decisions and their why, dead ends, conventions — indexed by kind (episodic/semantic/procedural) and scope. Ask it before re-deriving.

plugins.name: turn-end
plugins.description: The single blocking Stop hook, so no other plugin needs one. Plugins ship duties; one runner checks each against real state and emits ONE consolidated tail per request.

plugins.name: patterns
plugins.description: The named-pattern menu at the design moment, plus a pre-code check: 41 patterns from GoF, Fowler, POSA, Nystrom and Head First, each with its trigger, seam and drop-in test.

plugins.name: prism
plugins.description: Panel a question across sole-focus agents — one lens each (simple, decoupled, performant, extendable, sustainable, or any lens you name) — then compile the best points into one plan.

plugins.name: elicit
plugins.description: Brainstorm a vision to completion: it questions the gaps you leave, teaches the processes you have not worked with, panels genuine forks, and lands the conclusions in your project model.

plugins.name: mk-cc-all
plugins.description: Every skills-only plugin here in one install: essense-flow, elicit, prism, kb, schema-scout, project-note-tracker, session-lifecycle, plugin-toolkit. Hook-carrying plugins install separately.
